name: Christopher Potts
bio: Christopher Potts is a Professor of Linguistics at Stanford University with a courtesy appointment in Computer Science, and chairs the Linguistics department. Their research spans formal semantics and pragmatics and NLP topics such as model interpretability and evaluation. Potts is a co-author of the DSPy paper and of work on interpretability tools such as pyvene.
known_for: Co-author of the DSPy framework paper
Interpretability and evaluation of language models
